transcript: Habari team, this is Grace Wengiru, the CHV from Romai. I want to report on today's family planning outreach at Campi Amoto Dispensary. We started at 9 in the morning with a short talk on the different methods than the NASS systemerice bet gave services. In total, 42 women came and most of them were young mothers. Six women were referred to Romai Health Center for implants because we ran out of stock. One mama asked to be called for follow-up, her number is 0711000482. I will send the register tomorrow. Thank you.

Good evening everyone, it's faith aching. I was also at the Campi Amotto Outreach today with Grace. Just to confirm the numbers, we served 42 women on family planning and six were referred for implants. The turnout was very good even though the rain started around noon. The women asked if we can come back next month, so maybe we can plan that. If anyone needs the photos, call me on 0722000917 and I will share them on WhatsApp. Assanti.

Hello ladies, it's Rose in Jerry here. Sorry I missed the meeting this morning, the Matato from Solai broke down on the way and we waited for almost two hours. It was really bad. Anyway, I hope everyone is fine. Please remind me who is bringing the tea and mandatsi for Saturday. I can bring sugar. Also, if someone has a charger for a techno phone, I left mine at home. You can reach me on 073-0000-156. Okay, see you soon, bye bye.

Hi team, the Beatrice Latino here, reporting from the Too Many Women's Group Meeting in Magosiu. Today was our monthly table banking day. 25 members attended out of Tati. Together they saved 18,000 shillings, and we gave out four small loans to members who are starting businesses, mostly selling vegetables and secondhand clothes. The Trejara Mama Lucy Key Prop recorded everything in the book. Our next meeting is on the 15th. If you need the records, Lucy's number is 0745000638.

Morning everyone, this is Janet Mongi. Yesterday we went to Sarambia Primary School for the menstrual hygiene session with the girls in class 6 to 8. 60 girls attended. We talked about periods, how to use and dispose of pads safely, and why they should not miss school. At the end, every girl received a pack of usable sanitary pads. The head teacher, Mrs. Esther Koch, has asked us to come back and also talk to the mothers. Her phone number is 079000274 if someone wants to follow up.

Hello team, it's Masi Wambui. I want to share about the community dialogue on gender-based violence we held this afternoon at the Chiefs Camp in Solai. 35 women attended, plus a few village elders. The police gender desk officer, Corporal and Mutua, explained how to report cases and where survivors can get help. Some women shared their stories that was very emotional. Three women asked for private follow-up and we connected them with the consular. For anything about this session, you can call me on 0701-0000-593.

Hi everyone, Sister Nancy Shia Onoh here. Today we did the cervical cancer screening camp at Rona Health Center. We screened 28 women. Most results were normal, but 3 women had positive results, so we refat them to Nakuro Level 5 Hospital for Father treatment. One of them is Mrs Agnes Wairimu, and she has agreed to go on Monday. Please, whoever is going to Nakuro that day, help her with transport. Her number is 0768000341. I will upload the full report later.

e. Congratulations to Mama Parede Jeb2 on the new baby. We are so happy for you. Ladies, let's plan to visit her this weekend at her home in Cabarac after church. I suggest we each contribute 200 shillings for a small gift, maybe a baby blanket and some anger. Send your contribution to Ruth on Empessa, her number is 0756000819. And please don't forget to bring your own chairs last time we were standing. Ok, have a blessed evening.

Hello team, this is Caroline Nambura reporting from Campi Amoto. Today we held the kitchen garden training for women farmers. 18 women attended. The Agriculture Officer, Mr. Pita Lungat showed them how to make Asak garden and how to make compost from kitchen waste. Each woman received seedlings of Sukuma wiki and spinach to plant at home. Next month we will visit their homes to see how the gardens are doing. If you want to join the follow-up visits call me on 0712000765.

Good evening, this is Dray Smootoni. I was helping sister Nancy at the screening camp in Rungai today. Just adding to her report, we had 28 women screened for cervical cancer and three were referred to Nakuro Level 5. The women were very happy because many of them had never been screened before. Next time we should bring more chairs and water because the queue was long. My number is 0729008080 if you need anything from me.
